title: cinchona pitayensis var. trianae
intro: Cinchona pitayensis var. trianae, commonly known as the 'Yellow Cinchona', is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which offer several health benefits, including reducing fever and inflammation, and treating malaria and other diseases. The therapeutic actions of Cinchona pitayensis var. trianae are attributed to its ability to stimulate the heart and circulatory system, making it a valuable remedy for conditions such as palpitations and high blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like quinine and cinchonine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
